```json
  {"metric": "delay", "op": "<=", "value": 150e-12},
  {"metric": "energy", "op": "<=", "value": 300e-15}
 ],
 "topology": "StrongARM latch + output inverters",
 "rationale": "A StrongARM latch draws no static current; it only charges and discharges capacitance, so E is roughly C_sw*VDD^2. About 60 fF switched gives about 200 fJ. Minimum-L input pair at moderate gm/Id gives large initial gm for Av of about 5-10. The cross-coupled latch at L=0.15 regenerates with tau of about 10-15 ps, so ln(1.8/(Av*2 mV)) of about 5 means about 70 ps regeneration plus about 40 ps integration and inverter delay. That stays under 170 ps. Resetting all four internal nodes to VDD keeps the outputs equal during reset."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (10.0, 6.0, 16.0),      # input pair intent at evaluation start
    "I_in":    (200e-6, 50e-6, 800e-6),# per-side input current at evaluation start
    "Wt_ratio":(1.0, 0.5, 3.0),         # tail width relative to 2*W_in
    "Wln":     (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),         # latch nfet width [um]
    "Wlp":     (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),         # latch pfet width [um]
    "Wrst":    (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),        # reset pfet width [um]
    "Winv":    (1.0, 0.42, 6.0),        # output inverter nfet width [um] (pfet = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vdd = 1.8
    L = 0.15
    # Input pair sized at L=0.15 from gm/Id intent
    m_in = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], L, p["I_in"], vds=0.3)
    W_in = max(0.42, m_in.W)
    W_t = max(0.42, p["Wt_ratio"] * 2 * W_in)
    Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wi = p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wrst"], p["Winv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # Tail switch
    n.M("MT", "t", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_t, L)
    # Input pair
    n.M("M1", "dp", "vinp", "t", "vss", "nfet", W_in, L)
    n.M("M2", "dn", "vinn", "t", "vss", "nfet", W_in, L)
    # Cross-coupled latch (lp is above the vinp side and falls first when vinp>vinn)
    n.M("M3", "lp", "ln", "dp", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "ln", "lp", "dn", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "lp", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "ln", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # Reset switches (clk low) on all internal nodes
    n.M("MR1", "lp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR2", "ln", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR3", "dp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR4", "dn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # Output inverters: outp = NOT(lp) -> high when vinp>vinn
    n.M("MI1", "outp", "lp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI2", "outp", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("MI3", "outn", "ln", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI4", "outn", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cox_w = 1.0e-15   # ~F per um of width, gate + junction (L=0.15)
    c_latch = cox_w * (Wln + Wlp) * 2 + cox_w * Wr + cox_w * 3 * Wi  # per latch node
    c_d = cox_w * (W_in * 0.6 + Wln * 0.6 + Wr)                      # per integration node
    gm_n = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    gm_p = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    gm_lat = gm_n + gm_p
    tau = c_latch / max(gm_lat, 1e-6)
    i_in0 = lut.op("n", W_in, L, 0.9, 0.5)["Id"]
    t_int = c_d * 1.0 / max(i_in0, 1e-6)                    # dp/dn discharge ~ Vth
    av = max(1.0, m_in.gm * t_int / c_d) if c_d > 0 else 2.0
    t_reg = tau * math.log(vdd / 2 / (av * dv))
    t_inv = 0.69 * (cl + 2e-15) * 2.5e3 / max(Wi, 0.42)     # ~2.5k*um inverter resistance
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    c_sw = 2 * c_d + 2 * c_latch + cl + cox_w * W_t + 2 * cox_w * W_in
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2 + 2 * (cl + 3e-15 * Wi) * vdd ** 2 * 0.5
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
